paper_id.description: Opaque positive upstream identifier; not a count or student name.

offset.description: Zero-based item offset, default 0; not a page number.

all_user.description: Upstream all_user flag, default true; effective access is enforced by the supplied token.

latest.description: Upstream latest flag, default true. This paged read does not deduplicate different paper instances.

include_context.description: Return opaque per-record grading context, default false.
